title: 会議の投票受理
seriesHistory: First identified dedicated version in the examined public and migration inventories.
creatorAttributionSource: Parent task assignment record (high); no second runtime identity signal was available.

productionMeaning.meaning: A successful write into room.meeting.votes[player.id]. A voter can submit again, and the final vote may immediately end the meeting.
productionMeaning.fixture: The manual Play button supplies one accepted, own acknowledgement with a fresh local serial. The local serial is illustrative, not a production event ID. No target, skip value, role, player position, result, or vote total is consumed.

design.concept: An unmarked folded-corner sheet enters the mouth of a fixed meeting-desk receptacle. A light on the lip acknowledges the receipt once. This is a private UI metaphor.
design.coordinateSystem: Local pixels around an existing synthetic slot. Nominal CSS slot width 94 and sheet width 37 at scale 1, shrinking only when its display area demands it; real pixels use DPR.
design.phases: 0–240 ms present and align; 240–520 ms feed through a fixed clipping plane; contact light spreads along the two lips; 510–830 ms seat and extinguish. Neutral receptacle remains after the effect.
design.surfaceAndOptics: A broad paper face and single folded corner darken at the slot edge. Receiver accent and short local spill derive from the same contact signal. Lighting is synthetic UI illumination. No global flash or scene beam.
design.reducedMotion: Remove bank, horizontal travel and compression. Preserve the insertion and closing order.
design.sound: Finite mono paper friction during insertion, followed by a damped mechanical catch at 535 ms. A successful current GPU completion admits ordinary audio, offset by elapsed event time. Stop, replacement, page hide and verify interrupt or suppress it.

basis.applied: Finite cause and timing, material and silhouette, source-bound optical response, runtime WebGPU, corresponding SFX.

validation.nodeSyntax: PASS for preview module and executed receipt module
validation.receipt: Owner/accepted gates, nonpositive and fractional IDs, duplicate/stale suppression, and unread target getter passed.
validation.pcm: 8000,44100,48000,96000 Hz: early silence, sliding and seating signal, bounded finite amplitude and silent terminal sample. Initial strict equality distinguished -0 from +0; corrected assertion tests absolute zero. Runtime unchanged.
